title: Zohar Lazar
description: A pair of Imperial walkers patrol the fields. "As a diild watching STAR WARS, I remember being most impressed by the naturalistic movements given to the two and four-legged armored robots," says Zohar Lazar. "Cunning mixing and matching of live action and stop motion animation inspired hours of imaginary playtime in my Queens, NY backyard. This memory is what fueled my interest in the famous trilogy." Lazar is currently working on an illustrated book about "a fan, a lightbulb, and a radio."
